status_rule: After completing a task, set its check field to true. In future runs, only tasks with check false are eligible for work.
scope: Make the choices area responsive so long choice text does not overlap or create page-level horizontal scrolling. Exclude font-size slider work.
assumptions: The implementation target is the existing single-file viewer in index.html unless repository inspection shows the choices layout is defined elsewhere.
The answer_type and answer side panel should remain available, but it may stack below the main content at narrower widths if needed.
The solution should preserve existing data rendering behavior and only adjust layout/CSS/related class names necessary for responsive choices.
Font-size slider work is explicitly out of scope.

tasks.title: Locate choices layout and overflow sources
tasks.targets: index.html styles, markup, and rendering code related to choices, answer_type, answer, and detail layout
protected_fields: No file edits in this task
tasks.summary: Identify the CSS selectors and DOM structure that currently constrain choices width or force no-wrap behavior.
verify: Find the selectors/classes responsible for the choices grid or choices container.
Find any fixed width, min-width, grid column, flex, white-space, overflow, or MathJax-related styles that affect long choices.
Confirm whether the right-side answer metadata column contributes to the narrow choices area.

tasks.title: Define minimal responsive layout change
tasks.targets: CSS rules for detail layout and choices layout
allowed_fields: CSS custom properties only if already consistent with file style
tasks.summary: Choose the smallest CSS change that lets choices use available width and stack naturally when the container is narrow.
verify: Document whether choices should use auto-fit/minmax, a breakpoint to one column, or both.
Confirm the chosen min width cannot exceed 100% of the parent container.
Confirm the plan excludes a font-size slider.

tasks.title: Update choices wrapping behavior
allowed_fields: CSS for choices container and choice item elements
tasks.summary: Allow long choice text to wrap inside its own available width without overlapping neighboring choices.
verify: Confirm choice items have min-width: 0 where needed.
Confirm long text can wrap instead of overlapping adjacent choices.
Confirm any overflow behavior is local to the choice item only if wrapping is not possible for math content.

tasks.title: Update detail column responsiveness
tasks.targets: Main content and right metadata column layout
protected_fields: Sidebar behavior unless directly required by the layout fix
tasks.summary: Prevent the answer metadata column from forcing the choices area too narrow on medium or small viewports.
verify: Confirm the main content column can shrink with min-width: 0.
Confirm the metadata column stacks or resizes at the selected breakpoint.
Confirm the overall page does not gain horizontal scrolling from the detail grid.

tasks.title: Check representative responsive states
tasks.targets: Viewer UI at desktop, medium, and narrow widths
allowed_fields: Screenshot or DOM inspection notes if available
tasks.summary: Verify the choices area behaves correctly across the widths likely to reproduce the reported overlap.
verify: At a desktop width similar to the screenshot, choices do not overlap.
At a medium width, choices stack or reflow without page-level horizontal scroll.
At a narrow width, the right metadata area does not cover or squeeze choices.
Question stem, explanation, answer_type, and answer remain visible and readable.

tasks.title: Run final validation and update checklist
protected_fields: Completed task definitions unless scope changes are explicitly needed
tasks.summary: Validate the implementation and keep the checklist count in sync after work is complete.
verify: Parse index.html or run the available project validation command if one exists.
Parse this checklist JSON successfully.
Confirm completed task count in the filename matches tasks[*].check.
Move the checklist to docs/archive only if all tasks are complete.
